title: 心理学統計法
subtitle: Psychological Statistics
keywords: Data and Scales 2.Descriptive statistics 3.Population and sample 4.Statistical tests
educationalGoal: Statistical analysis is required for psychological research with high generalizability. The goal of this course is to provide students with the basic knowledge to run statistical tests and to understand the results of the tests precisely.
advice: The class proceeds with lectures on the basic theory of psychological statistics and practical training of statistical analyses that include calculations with real data using Microsoft Excel and R. Students are expected to understand the basics of psychological statistics and learn the method of statistical analysis to avoid misuse of statistical analysis and misinterpretation of the results of analyses. Note that the course flow can be changed according to other closely related courses such as “Practice of Elementary Psychological Experiments.”
books: 心理学統計法 清水裕士 NHK出版
requiredKnowledge: Students are required to bring their own personal computer for statistical analysis.

activityGoals.body: Ability to decide which statistical analyses are appropriate for the data acquired in experiments and surveys.
Ability to run statistical analyses with appropriate methods and to interpret the results in appropriate ways.
Ability to understand the selection, computation, and interpretation of descriptive statistics.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
 ※学習課題の時間欄には、指定された学習課題に要する標準的な時間を記載してあります。日々の自学自習時間全体としては、各授業に応じた時間(例えば2単位科目の場合、予習2時間・復習2時間/週)を取るよう努めてください。詳しくは教員の指導に従って下さい。
